sources_consulted: OEIS A006037, revision 28 June 2026, read via https://raw.githubusercontent.com/oeis/oeisdata/master/seq/A006/A006037.seq
review.notes: This is a reference-only module: it contains two imports and a module docstring, with no declarations or status tags of its own. The relevant imported theorem, Erdos470.erdos_470.parts.i, faithfully asks whether ∃ n : ℕ, n.Weird ∧ Odd n. Mathlib's definitions match the sources, including distinct positive proper divisors, strict abundance, and exclusion of every subset summing to n. Zero cannot supply a spurious witness. In /workspace/review/scratch.lean, I proved equivalence with the expanded source definition without using sorry, tested boundary cases and the examples 12, 70, and 836, and checked all n ≤ 100. Wikipedia and the Erdős source still record the existence question as open. Direct OEIS and Erdős requests were blocked; their content was read through the mirror/text reader listed above.
